notes.title: Update # Rival GYM 🤜💪
notes.notes:
With the new update, a Rival GYM will appear next to the park after reaching level 8.

You can break its windows with stones found nearby, throw trash inside, and scare away its customers by slapping them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/879f98ffae8013c31a0d956a4ef415be4d3d4c43.png

In this way, you can reduce the Rival GYM's health and eventually make it go bankrupt.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/661ed865059d4ac41c153aeeb96eeb1a7b0efba7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/c0daa3af51b3338808fbb65a0891673714b7e13e.png

After the Rival GYM goes bankrupt, you can add all the equipment inside to your inventory and place them in your own GYM.

Note: Recently, we have received reports of issues with playing YouTube videos on the TVs inside the GYM. This is due to recent changes by YouTube. We are working to resolve this issue as soon as possible.

notes.title: Version 1.0 and Upcoming Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have decided to release the full version of our game for players who have been waiting because we have completed all the features we promised in the "Upcoming Features" list, as well as some additional features that were not listed. Currently, the only missing feature is the multiplayer mode.

Releasing the full version does not mean we are abandoning the game.
Here are some features we still plan to add:

 Rival Gym (Coming Next Week)
 Economy Updates (Coming Next Week)
 The ability for players to train and build muscle
 Real-time reflective mirrors
 New Employees
and two major features that we want to keep as a surprise for now.

Here are the features we have added so far:

 Cleaning Staff
 Swimming Pool, Swimming Pool Equipment, and Customers in Swimwear
 Equipment Repair Staff
 A Massive Upper Floor
 Protein Bar/Restaurant with a chef
 Security Guard
 Punching Bag
 Group Classes and Group Class Instructor
 Pet System
 New Training Equipment
 Boxing Cage and Boxing Instructor
 Air Conditioning
 TVs that can play YouTube videos and be placed throughout the gym
 A Blackjack Table in the Backstreet Bar
 A Nightclub where you can find a partner, dance, and have drinks
Thank you very much for giving us a chance and purchasing our game. Although we strive to meet all of our players' requests, unfortunately, this is not always possible. However, we have added the most important features you wanted, and we have outlined the features we will add above.

Upcoming Our Games

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062170/The_Enigma_Cases/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062150/Car_Service_Simulator/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062050/Drive_Thru_Simulator__Prologue/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393240/Banker_Simulator/?curator_clanid=44123520

See you in future updates!

notes.title: Update # Group Workouts 🧘‍♂️🧘🧘‍♀️
notes.notes:
After a long break, we are back with a fantastic update: The Group Workout System!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/a69d301f96393b8b9966cc83cd2bb97ae38c8118.png

After opening one of the group workout rooms located on the second floor, you can organize group workouts at specific times during the day.

You can purchase group workout rooms from the Group Training menu on the computer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/df56d87d32847b5800fccaa1c2e95653f5a33b9f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/8ab05a30e3b13eb49ac3e47061680ecac31ec45d.png

You can set the times of the group workouts by interacting with the "Clock object" located above the room. As your level increases, you will have the right to conduct more group workouts throughout the day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/f93a012e54b7941e9e69e3d072acd439ad7bc3ea.png

If you do not hire an instructor, you can manage the group workout yourself and earn money based on your success in the workout. If you hire an instructor, they will automatically manage the customers during the workout hour.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/392c3753148d521e875d5e582fe6a3a53c2b6798.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/254d70e4a8fa475901f63c6298fde04f65887e94.png

notes.title: Update # Air Conditioner And Video Play On TVs 📺
notes.notes:
Air Conditioner 

Now your customers will smell less. The more air conditioners you install in your gym, the less likely it is that your customers will smell.
Where can I buy it? : You can find the air conditioner in the Extras section of the Shop menu on your computer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/e002533fdd4b05ebfba9f3d9c035db1178f62ebf.png

Video Play On TVs 📺

Tired of the TVs being off? Now you can play your favorite videos on the televisions you've installed in the GYM.
(Currently, to avoid copyright issues, videos are played with the sound off. However, you can play music through a music player at the same time. New musics will be added with future updates.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/70732c1b9d9c86db55ccf2b94d8f8bc6581f4a12.png

You can play any YouTube video by entering its URL into the TV menu on your computer.

notes.title: New Update # Pool System and New Characters
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/037404608fb6b9dadd55c893739d9bfb3b310e6f.png

The much anticipated update to Gym Simulator 24 is finally here!
With the new update, you'll be able to improve and expand your gym and allow customers to interact with it more.
Also, our customer characters have been replaced with nicer and more realistic looking versions.


Pool Management System 🏊

One of the biggest innovations in this update is the addition of a pool management system in-game. Players can take a dip in the pools of fitness centers to cool off after a workout or just have a pleasant swimming experience. Realistic water effects and swimming mechanics will enhance customers' enjoyment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/9ea74c7afe83fc5eaae0f00f1409f56fe2097307.png

To open the pool, you first need to buy the 2nd Gym. Then you can access the pool area by breaking the wooden wall inside. After that, all you have to do is open the valve, fill the pool and install cabins in the changing rooms!
If you wish, you can also arrange sun loungers around the pool and let your customers relax in front of the pool.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548416/d7ca2070b83948302cefc452f39c1aff4977e527.png

New Customer Characters


We have tried to improve the visual quality of the game with new and realistic client characters and to make the gym look more pleasing.
With the new characters, clients now have better workout clothes and bikinis and swimsuits for swimming in the pool.
